description: This source file defines the CreditCard class, which models credit card information within an e-commerce system. It serves as an embeddable entity for persisting credit card details such as card type, owner, number, expiration date, and CVV. The class provides getter and setter methods for each attribute and relies on annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: CreditCard
classes.description: A Java class representing credit card details used in payment processing, embeddable in other entities.
